name: 集中寻源 (3ZF)
description_en_html:
Overview

Central Sourcing provides centralized access and visibility into sourcing process across industries with deep integration into the system landscape. It is connected to the customer's ERP systems and exchanges purchasing documents (such as purchase requisitions, purchase orders, and contracts) in the connected systems.

This scope item offers one platform where a procurement specialist can work centrally on purchase requisitions from multiple ERP systems to identify the ideal source of supply. A request for quotation (RFQ) can be created for multiple requisitions from different ERP systems. The supplier quotations received can be maintained and an RFQ can be awarded. Follow-on actions (like creating a central contract or purchase order in the corresponding ERP system) can be centrally controlled in the hub system.

Strategic procurement tasks including Supplier Management benefit from the transparency and the possibility to initiate strategic activities from a central digital procurement control center.

Key Process Flow

  • Create and approve purchase requisitions
  • Create central request for quotations
  • Manage central request for quotations
  • Create supplier quotations and award request for quotations
  • Create the corresponding central contracts or purchase orders
  • Update the purchase requisition process status electronically while processing the goods receipt and the supplier invoice

Business Benefits

  • Harmonize business process
  • Get full transparency over all activities
  • Ensure usage of centrally negotiated prices and contracts
  • Provide single data access for employees and possibility to process procurement activities centrally (for example, sourcing, completion of requisitions, approval, and so on)
  • Reduce TCO significantly for procurement departments through centralized process
description_zh_html:
概览

集中寻源通过深度集成到系统架构中，提供对跨行业寻源流程的集中访问和可见性。它连接到客户的 ERP 系统，并在连接的系统中交换采购凭证（例如采购申请、采购订单和合同）。

此范围项目提供了一个平台，采购专家可以在其中集中处理来自多个 ERP 系统的采购申请，以确定理想的货源。可以为来自不同 ERP 系统的多个请购单创建报价请求 (RFQ)。可以维护收到的供应商报价并授标询价。可以在中心系统中集中控制后续操作（例如在相应 ERP 系统中创建集中合同或采购订单）。

战略采购任务（包括供应商管理）受益于从中央数字采购控制中心发起战略活动的透明度和可能性。

关键流程流

  • 创建并审批采购申请
  • 创建集中询价
  • 管理集中询价
  • 创建供应商报价并授标询价
  • 创建相应的集中合同或采购订单
  • 在处理收货和供应商发票时，以电子方式更新采购申请处理状态

业务优势

  • 协调业务流程
  • 全面了解所有活动
  • 确保使用集中协商的价格和合同
  • 为员工提供单一数据访问以及集中处理采购活动的可能性（例如，寻源、完成申请、审批等）
  • 通过集中流程显著降低采购部门的总体拥有成本
